reviews.text: A great place for furry friends, very professional in their work.

The service is fast, clear, specific, and of very good quality. They are empathetic and answer all your questions. I received my consultation by phone, and they resolved all my doubts. I recommend them 100%.
They are excellent caregivers and trainers, very kind, and their attention to the dogs is 10 out of 10.

Excellent! 👌 I took my dog ​​there for behavioral issues. He completed all seven levels and still goes to daycare for socialization. It's a place where they treat dogs incredibly well. His trainer, Raquel, and the branch manager, Armando, as well as the entire team, are excellent. It's a safe space for your pet with qualified staff who always treat them with kindness and warmth. My dog ​​🐕 loves going.

Congratulations to the Canine Integration team! They are excellent. They are incredibly attentive, and their treatment of the animals is outstanding. I wholeheartedly recommend them. The dogs learn so much here, and they have complete peace of mind knowing they are well cared for. My dog ​​is being trained very well, respectfully, and without any mistreatment!

Ten months ago, we rescued a Pitbull and found places to lovingly shelter her. But to find her a family, we needed a place that, in addition to caring for and training her, would fill her with love and trust. Integración Canina gave Laika loving care, gentle and effective training, and opened the door to her new family. Six months of training and good treatment, thanks to all the caregivers and trainers; 100% recommended. Today, Laika has found a family and will finally be adopted. They are careful with all the dogs, their food, and provide excellent treatment.

Excellent place to take your best friend for training classes. They are very professional and knowledgeable about canine matters. They demonstrate a high level of commitment to the dogs. It's worth every penny.

Excellent treatment of the dogs and very kind and patient during the classes with the owners. The changes in my dog's behavior were very quick and evident, and there are many dogs and they all seem happy. Highly recommended.
Excellent service! The person who helps you is genuinely interested in your dog and explains everything in detail. They treat my pets very well and are very professional.

I left my dogs there for 7 days to be cared for and bathed, and the service was truly excellent. My dogs left very happy. The place is also quite large, with many dogs of all breeds living together, and they all seem very happy. I highly recommend this place, and if there were stars, I would give them 10,000,000! ☺️🤗☺️👍👌 …
